title: New Orleans Jazz Club officers and members
summary: Myra Menville as secretary and Dr. Sushan as active member; neither man remembers jazz club people at Manny's or El Morocco.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution

blocks.x: with Elton Pernell and Joe Watkins and Drag and Lawrence and Jim who at one point was out and Waldron Joseph called Frog came in but that was very brief maybe a couple of weeks or something a substitute maybe a couple of nights I don't know okay let's see now Myra Menville do you remember any official position she had?
well I think she was secretary of New Orleans Jazz Club
that's what I remember at that time
she may have been I suspect she was at one point president but I don't remember when it may have been later on yeah she certainly was very interested in what she was doing
and Dr. Edmond Sushan was a uh...
he was very active I think in the Jazz Club too
and of course most of the people in the Jazz Club I never knew had no occasion to meet them in that city other than up there
I was very much in the same position yeah

I don't remember a lot of them coming to Manny's to hear George Lewis or coming to the El Malaco to hear George Lewis or coming to the uh... famous star I suppose that's just typical people in the lawn
I don't remember any of them doing it oh I'm sure some of them must have at one time or another yeah
